page.layout: Running head at top: page number "172" at left, running title "De Juramenti Obligatione" at right. One column of running text, with one marginal note in the left margin beside the paragraph "Dubium primum". Below the last line, the catchword "mus" at right.

main_text.p: aggredimur. Verborum autem sensum hic intelligo, non respectu formularum, quibus aliquid jurari significatur; (de hac enim inter dignoscendi Juramenti κρίσεως[?], dum in externa forma versamur, ante dictum est :) sed respectu ipsius promissionis, quæ jurejurando confirmatur, & in verbis continetur. Res sane magni momenti, & multiplicis usus: utroque nomine digna omni vestra attentione. Etenim & magni interest pernosse quo sensu juraveris; quia pejeravit, qui quod promissum est non eo sensu perfecerit, quo promisit, aut promittere debuit: nec in solis Juramentis, sed & in Votis, Promissis, Fœderibus, Contractibus, aliisque conventionibus omnibus, in quibus bona fide agier oportet, omnino videndum ut promissio eo prorsus sensu quo facta est adimpleatur. Ad rem ergo, Juramenti verba, aut clara sint necesse est, aut ambigua.
main_text.head: SECT. II.
main_text.p: Casus 4Dubium primum est de Obligatione Juramenti, cujus verba clara sunt, & habent sensum manifestum & indubitatum. Ubi quatuor occurrunt casus. Pri-

page.notes: The Greek word after "Juramenti" is hard to read; I read it as κρίσεως but the letters are not certain. The catchword "mus" is the second half of "Primus" and is kept in the catchword element only. The printed ":)" is copied as printed. The left margin note reads "Casus 4" (printed as "Cafus 4").
